composition.serve_who: This sheet ("SW 108-01 - Wiring Schematic", Termodinamica) is the dedicated wiring/interconnection diagram for the ships' AIRCON SYSTEM (590-aircon-system). It shows the two engine-room VRV18E1 compressor units (PORT and STBD, each = 590-aircon-compressor-1/2), their seawater cooling pumps (595-grundfos-main-seawater-cooling-pumps, per established alias TMD100 sea water pump), and the full set of distributed fan-coil/air-handler units per cabin (each -> its own 590-aircon-fancoil-* node per the register), tied together by BUS MASTER/SLAVE control lines, touch-screen interfaces, and an internet/Modbus bridge. All labelled loads on this sheet are named for aircon zones (Fwd/Aft Guest, Salon, Galley, Crew cabins, Owner's cabin) confirming this whole sheet serves 590-aircon-system and its children exclusively. The BUS/switch/network infrastructure (Switch BUS Box, Bus Master/Slave lines, Ethernet LAN, TMD Internet Interface, TMD Bridge, AC/DC Current Sensor) is shared control/monitoring infrastructure for the aircon system as a whole, not a piece of any single fancoil.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: VRV18E1 Engine Room Port (Aircon Compressor Unit 1)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Labelled 'VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT' box, fed from Main Switchboard breaker B1 40A, drives its own sea water pump and is BUS MASTER for the port-side distributed fancoil chain — matches register's per-unit compressor node.

functions.label: Compressor power supply & ground
functions.what_it_does: Supplies 230VAC compressor power to the PORT VRV18E1 unit from the main switchboard, with an independent compressor ground/anode (never shared with other devices per warning note).

flow_scenarios.path: Main Switchboard -> Breaker B1 (40A, C or D curve) -> L+N+PE 3x6mm2 -> VRV18E1 Engine Room Port compressor; compressor ground wire -> independent anode/zinc (must not connect to any other device, else warranty void)

facts: Two independent bus trees (Port via BUS MASTER LINE 1, Stbd via BUS MASTER LINE 2) join at the Switch BUS Box Connection, forming a single control network across both VRV18E1 units and all fancoils.
BUS SLAVE LINE (magenta, 2x2x0.75mm² <10m / +1.5mm² <20m / +2.5mm² 20-40m) daisy-chains each fancoil's Therm/control interface back to its side's Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 and bus master.

INTERNET ROUTER supplies Ethernet LAN (UTP CAT.5) to the TMD Internet Interface (80 W @ 24VDC) and to Touch Screen 7 (TS7E 7" Exor touch screen), enabling remote/network monitoring of the whole aircon system.

Each side carries an AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS (mod. QI-50-V-485, Addr.31, 5W@24VDC) and a TMD Bridge (Addr.32, RS485 Modbus RTU, 5W@24VDC) — shared monitoring/gateway devices for that side's bus, not attached to any single fancoil.

BUS cable specification notes: min 0.5mm²/max 1.0mm² section, 100-120 ohm impedance, 50-60pF/m capacitance max, twisted pair with shield grounded only at compressor box side (not at air handler electronic panel); DC power supply (24VDC/GND) must be run as a single line from one source, not mixed sources.
To enter the PCB (air handler electronic panel) use wire 2x2x0.75mm² at any time (installation note).
Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 appears once per side (port and stbd), each 10W @ 24VDC, providing local HMI for that side's zone group.

Inset detail drawings (right of sheet) document internal wiring for: SyxthSense Touch Screen Connection, VRV18E1 Terminal Block Connection, SyxthSense Touch Screen & SubSlave Air Handler Connection, Air Handler Wiring, Air Handler Port/Stbd Connection, Air Handler Master/Slave Connection, TS7E 7" Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces Connection, AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS wiring, and Switch BUS Box Connection internals — these are wiring detail views of the same infrastructure, not separate systems.
